questions.question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the daughter of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B' and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B'.

If 'P + Q ÷ R × S - T', then based on the above, how is P related to T?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68649cacfa98245f0ceb36f716a73c5c632a9f59d024076540dec2107071feb2.png] 

Given expression: P + Q ÷ R × S - T

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Daughter 

 
 
 
Brother 

 
 
 
Wife 

 
 
 
Father 

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

 

P + Q: P is the daughter of Q.

Q ÷ R: Q is the father of R.

R × S: R is the wife of S. 

S - T: S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52e241efc6fb6b5186c4dc68d0a78c49fd53f72f11d838dcc69d46e3a3f5af3e.png] 

Thus, P is brother's wife's sister of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

19 + 55 × 5 - 7 ÷ 3 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

Given equation: 19 + 55 × 5 - 7 ÷ 3 = ?

After interchanging ‘+’ and ‘−’ and ‘×’ and ‘÷’, we get:

19 − __**55 ÷ 5**__ + 7 × 3 = ?

= 19 − 11 + __**7 × 3**__

= __**19 − 11**__ + 21

= 8 + 21

= 29

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1-L, M, N and O are seated and all of them are facing south. In row 2-P, Q, R and S are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus, each person faces another person from the other row. Q sits to the immediate right of S. Only two people sit between L and M. S faces L. The one who faces N, sits to the immediate left of P. R does not sit at any of the extreme ends.

Who among the following faces O?
questions.solution:
Given:

Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1- L, M, N and O are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2- P, Q, R and S are seated and all of them are facing north.

Only two people sit between L and M. S faces L.

R does not sit at any of the extreme ends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
